newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS CLOSE HIGHER ON SELECTIVE BUYING.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS CLOSE HIGHER ON SELECTIVE BUYING.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended slightly higher on selective buying of mostly blue chips in engineering and food sectors by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all- share price index gained 1.75 points or 0.18 percent to 954.89 on turnover of 50 million taka. Losers led gainers by 83 to 67.
"There was selective buying in engineering and food sectors by retailers. This helped the index to rise slightly despite fall of majority shares," said one broker.

Bangladesh Lamps gained 629 taka to 4,828 on news that the company might offer one-for-one bonus share and 15 percent dividend for the year ended on December 31. The company's AGM is due on August 22.
"The market sentiment has improved a bit by the news," said another broker.
Apex Foods gained 113 to 1,493 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals rose 2.95 to 129.71 which was the volume leader with 33,150 trading.
